_comment: Positions of the exit-graph nodes (backend/app/exit_router.py) on the Command Centre map.
SCHEMATIC: these are layout positions on a 1000 x 640 canvas, chosen so no walkways cross; they are
not surveyed coordinates and distances are not to scale. Replace x/y with real positions (e.g. traced
from OpenStreetMap and scaled to this canvas) when the site map is available; keep schematic=true until then.
kind: zone (a monitored Ramkund area), ghat, or gate (an exit gate). Every node of the exit graph needs an entry.
label_at (optional): where the name goes, below (default), above, left or right, to keep it off the walkways.
